Laurey 57220, Transitional Newport 128mm Cabinet Pull in Matte Black

The 128mm Newport Cabinet Pull in Matte Black is a stunning example of transitional kitchen hardware. It offers a sleek profile that isn't too modern so it will add a touch of home to your cabinets. The Large Matte Black Newport Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware you'll need. The Laurey 57220 Transitional Newport 128mm Cabinet Pull in Matte Black is suitable for use on any lightweight door or drawer.

This transitional cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Newport Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 57220 128mm Pull Newport Matte Black:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 5" (128mm)
  • Overall Length: 5.87"
  • Width: 0.41"
  • Projection: 1.18"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
